hooks.command: [ -d .git ] || exit 0; [ -f .vault-meta/auto-commit.disabled ] && exit 0; if [ -x scripts/wiki-lock.sh ]; then LOCK_LIST=$(bash scripts/wiki-lock.sh list 2>/dev/null); LOCK_RC=$?; if [ "$LOCK_RC" != "0" ]; then mkdir -p .vault-meta 2>/dev/null; printf '%s wiki-lock list failed rc=%s; deferred auto-commit\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$LOCK_RC" >> .vault-meta/hook.log 2>/dev/null; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$LOCK_LIST" ]; then exit 0; fi; fi; git add -- wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null && (git diff --cached --quiet -- wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ || git commit -m "wiki: auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" -- wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null) || true
